name: ST-NeRF
aliases: ST-NeRF — Spatially and temporally consistent NeRF
definition: A layered representation for editable free-viewpoint videos that relies on bounding boxes for all independently moving and articulated objects, resulting in multiple layers, and disentangles their positions, deformations and appearance.
summary: ST-NeRF is a layered radiance field for dynamic scenes that disentangles position, deformation, and appearance to enable precise editing of independently moving objects.
